facts.fact: The Libya Observer says Prime Minister Dbeibah announced in January 2025, under the 1,000 Entrepreneurs for 1,000 Projects initiative, a support fund and regulations governing startup companies; adoption of the regulations is not stated.
Tripoli Central Municipality inaugurated the city's first business incubator for startup entrepreneurs on 10 August 2025, with UNDP support; no programme or cohort is described.
